profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a seasoned software engineer with a strong background in innovative engineering practices. With a meticulous approach, I specialize in developing and refining back-end applications, leveraging a diverse skill set encompassing multiple programming languages and cutting-edge technologies.

My proficiency includes expertise in programming languages such as Java, C, C++, C#, HTML, JavaScript, CSS, XML, Python, and experience with Linux/Unix environments. Additionally, I am adept at database management using SQL and utilize a range of tools including Eclipse IDE, Visual Studio IDE, NetBeans IDE, Putty, and Jenkins to streamline development processes.

Having honed my skills over years of hands-on experience, I excel in defining project requirements, designing robust solutions, and conducting comprehensive testing to ensure optimal performance and reliability. My approach is grounded in methodologies such as Scrum, Agile Software Development, and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), enabling me to deliver high-quality products efficiently and effectively.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Scrum Mastery & Agile Leadership: Lead Agile ceremonies: sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives. Foster a continuous improvement culture for optimal team performance.
Software Development & Testing: Develop C++ solutions adhering to industry standards. Conduct comprehensive testing: unit, integration, and system testing.
Integration Support & Cross-Team Collaboration: Serve as liaison between development teams. Collaborate with stakeholders to address dependencies and
drive success.

positions.title: College Student Tech Sr Spec
positions.description: Investigated technical challenges to identify the root cause and provide expedient resolutions. Wrote clean, clear, and well-tested code for various projects. Collaborated with other developers to identify and alleviate a number of bugs and errors in software. Developed, implemented, and optimized stored procedures and functions using SQL.

positions.title: College Student Tech Sr Spec
positions.description: Researched, tested, and implemented a new security application using Linux to allow for naval soldiers to pass information through an encrypted passage while on deployment . Documented setup, network structure, and test plans as a member of the SQQ-89 Cybersecurity development team.

positions.title: Gaming Floor Desk Lead
positions.description: Provided management and oversight for all operations of the Student Center Game Center. Worked with the Director of Student Union Operations & Events and the Student Center Manager to create and implement a training program for Game Center desk operations. Oversaw the 2nd floor of the Student Center in the evening hours including the Game Center Desk, building, and inventory during assigned shifts. Ran reports for daily event resources and communicate needs of the Student Center, offering areas for improvement. Developed a schedule for regular desk hours, holidays, and vacation time periods.

positions.title: College Student Tech Spec
positions.description: Designed and tested a newly implemented threat detection program using JNI, that would allow naval soldiers to generate SVG files and transfer to a map for later inspection. Assisted with bay testing to receive feedback and make adjustments as the customer needed.

honors.title: Senior Service Award
honors.description:
Theta Phi Alpha’s Senior Service Award is the highest award granted to a collegiate member. This
national award is presented in recognition of a collegiate member in her senior year whose scholarship,
leadership, character, and service to Fraternity and school has been outstanding during all of her years as a collegian.
honors.issuer: Issued by Theta Phi Alpha · May 2020

projects.title: Semantic Security
projects.description:
Graduate Research Project - Worked on
Leveraging Web User Analysis through Ontologies to Intelligently Generate Reliable Security Questions

projects.title: DRL Sim 3 Drone
projects.description: Designed and modeled a drone using DRL Sim 3. Research conducted included real-time supplies that would affect the characteristics of the drone during a race. Entire project was conducted virtually.

organizations.name: Theta Phi Alpha
organizations.position: Special Awards Chair, New Member Educator, Philanthropy Chair · Aug 2019 - May 2020
